questions.text: For anyone who's streamed or posted: what was your first one like, and how many people watched?
What actually makes you follow a creator — and what makes you unfollow instantly?
What makes a stream chat good? Name the thing that ruins one fastest.
Do you prefer small streams where you're known by name, or big ones with the energy? Why?
If you had to make content about one thing forever, what would it be?
What do you think viewers massively underestimate about making content?
Which creator have you supported the longest, and what keeps you around?
Which two creators should collaborate and absolutely never will?
What content trend do you wish would die, and which one deserves more attention?
What do you have playing while you do chores, work, or fall asleep?
Who was the first creator you properly followed, and are they still going?
Whose setup, studio, or workspace do you envy most?
Can you tell when a creator is faking it? What gives it away?
Would you ever stream or post publicly? What's actually stopping you?
What makes a community feel well run rather than just heavily policed?
What's the best clip you've ever seen from a live stream?
What's the most ridiculous stunt, challenge, or marathon you've watched someone attempt?
Which creator have you genuinely learned a skill from?
If every platform vanished except one, which should survive and why?
Do you read comments? Do you post them? What's your policy?
What's the best thing you've seen a community pull off together?
Have you watched a creator visibly burn out? What should the audience have done differently?
Are you a lurker or a chatter? Be honest, and tell us why.
What creator or channel from years ago do you still go back and rewatch?
What's the most niche content you regularly consume that nobody else you know cares about?
If you ran a platform for a day, what's the one thing you'd change first?
What stream alert, sound, or overlay is genuinely good, and which are unbearable?
What's the most shameless title or thumbnail that still got you to click?
What's the most valuable way to support a creator that costs nothing?
How did you find the last creator you started watching regularly?
Have you ever made content and stopped? What made you stop, and would you go back?
What feedback would you actually want if you posted something, and what would just hurt?
Which platform's old version do you miss, and what did they break?
Can you watch something and do something else properly, or is one of them getting shortchanged?
Long form, short form, live, or written — what format actually holds your attention?
What's a community you're in that has a joke you'd have to explain for ten minutes?
